legitimateExplanations.title: Contact details for an existing carrier have changed.
legitimateExplanations.actually: Genuine rebranding, domain migration, office relocation, or acquisition.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Confirm the change through the pre-existing channel, not the new one, and require confirmation from a known contact. A genuine change survives verification through the old channel; a takeover does not.

legitimateExplanations.title: Bank account name differs from the operator name.
legitimateExplanations.actually: Legitimate use of a factoring company or a group treasury account, which is common in road freight.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Require a written assignment or factoring agreement, and verify it with the factor directly. Legitimate factoring is documented and verifiable.

legitimateExplanations.title: A primary administrator or account owner changes shortly before a movement.
legitimateExplanations.actually: A genuine ownership transfer, staff change, leave cover or managed-service transition.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Verify the change through the previously known operator channel, record the effective date and preserve the old-to-new administrator audit trail.

countermeasures.text: Run automated lookalike-domain detection against the domains of onboarded carriers.
Notify the impersonated operator, which is a victim and will usually cooperate, and which may already hold evidence.
